claim: When replacing a plotter, reproduce its exact end state (registers, flags, stack push, self-modified operands); running the original once over a mapped RAM canvas page is a way to get the exact register state.

evidence.text: Plotters A and B are converted to sprites; the plotters use self-modified operands and a PUSH AF on the game stack with no DI (4,299 A and 1,058 B plots converted in the RZX).
The original plotter is run once over canvas RAM page 29 for the exact register state, then sprite attributes are staged; AF' may hold a canvas byte, which verify proves dies.
